title: A developer argues that companies should ship agent-ready APIs before AI sidebars
friendlyTitle: Build a good API before adding another AI chat box
summary: Developer Will Wang argues that companies should expose their core functions through well-designed APIs instead of prioritising another product-specific chatbot. He calls for token-efficient interfaces, fine-grained permissions, human-review hooks, documentation and examples that agents can use as skills.
friendlySummary: Will Wang says companies should let AI agents use clear, secure APIs instead of making every agent click through a website or use a new chat panel.
whyItMatters: Agents are faster and more reliable when they can call a structured interface instead of clicking through a visual dashboard. Product teams can make existing services more useful to both automation and people by exposing narrow actions, clear permissions and approval points.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Good APIs make automation faster and easier to control. They can also let a person approve important steps before an agent continues.
